name: UI：生产看板-指标卡片/链路进度/数据一致性验证
description: 验证生产看板：整体推送进度(总任务数/生产中/已推送/未推送)、链路生产进度表格，数据非空且文案正确

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card], [class*=stat]')).map(c => c.textContent.trim().substring(0, 80)); return { cards, count: cards.length }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const metrics = ['总任务数', '生产中', '已推送', '未推送']; const found = metrics.filter(m => text.includes(m)); return { metrics, found, coverage: found.length + '/' + metrics.length }; })()
(() => { const tables = document.querySelectorAll('table, .ant-table'); return { tableCount: tables.length }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在生产数据。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 看板包含：整体推送进度(总任务数/生产中/已推送/未推送卡片)、链路生产进度(按链路展示表格)。
